title: perf(metadata-protocol,rest,runtime): /meta/app judges its navigation on the execution face; diagnostics verdicts are memoized by content and schema
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D7ZazGN9DENufYRJ7p13Wia)_

Closes #25783

Clause-②: yes (widening): the exported `RestProtocol` type of `@objectstack/rest` gains one optional member, `getMetaItemsForExecution?`. Measured on the built `dist/index.d.ts` at `cb0a2fcf` and at `22f886e1`: rest's export list is unchanged (67 names) and, outside doc comments, that member is the only changed line; the `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` and `@objectstack/runtime` declarations are byte-identical.
Metadata-protocol: none

A read-path cost change. No accept set, served body, route parameter or error code changes, and nothing under `packages/spec` or `ui/` moves. The one published type that changes is `RestProtocol`, by the optional member above (changeset `.changeset/25783-rest-meta-app-execution-face.md`); all three packages stay `patch`, as `Metadata-protocol: none` requires. The served bytes of six metadata types were hashed before and after and are identical (below).

## What changes

**1. `GET /meta/app` judges its navigation on the protocol's execution face** (`packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`).
The nav-servability gate (`resolveNavServability`, #24031) reads each object's `enable` to prune the nav entries whose object refuses `list`. It read them through `loadObjectItems` → `metaListSource` → the served `getMetaItems`, which stamps `_diagnostics` on every object, so each `/meta/app` read ran a full zod `safeParse` of every object definition only to read `enable`. Measured at 63 of 73 ms CPU per read. `RestServer.metaListSource` now asks `getMetaItemsForExecution` for `object` when the protocol has it: the same list, without the serving decorations (the #24031 / #24535 precedent for `/data`). The dispatcher's `metaItemReadGateSources.listMetaItems` does the same (seat amendment 6407727649), so `/meta/app` through the `${prefix}/*` catch-all gets the same cut. A protocol without the execution face is asked `getMetaItems` as before. `RestProtocol` gains the optional `getMetaItemsForExecution` member; `MetaDomainProtocol` gains it in its existing partial pick of the protocol type. Book and doc lists stay on the served face (their readers want the served shape).

**2. Diagnostics verdicts are memoized by schema and content** (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/metadata-diagnostics.ts`).
`computeMetadataDiagnostics` keeps one bounded LRU (4096 entries) per schema object, held in a `WeakMap`, keyed by a SHA-256 of the stripped document. The key encodes everything the parse can tell apart: plain JSON documents key on `JSON.stringify`; a document holding `undefined` (a strict schema refuses an undeclared key whose value is `undefined`, and an array hole parses as `undefined`) keys on an encoding that spells `undefined` out; a document holding anything without a faithful key (a function, a class instance, `NaN`/`Infinity`, `-0`, nesting past 256) is parsed every time, as before. A `registerMetadataTypeSchema` replacement is a new schema object and starts from nothing. Each caller gets its own copy of the verdict. The inputs are only the schema and the document: no global zod error map is installed anywhere, and the node-config contract maps the refinements read are fixed after first build. This is not a cache of any read's answer; it sits below every merge, on a pure function of its own input, so a metadata change is a different document and a different key. `protocol.ts` is untouched (0 lines).

## Measured

Showcase app (`examples/app-showcase`, 108 objects), local, signed in as the seeded admin. Main-thread CPU per request from `/proc/PID/task/PID/stat` over 40 serial requests after 5 warm-ups; shares from a V8 CPU profile at 250 µs sampling over 40 more. Shared box (4 cores), so read the ratios.

| Endpoint | CPU before (`cb0a2fcf`) | CPU after (`a8f08c97`) | `computeMetadataDiagnostics` share before → after |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| `GET /api/v1/meta/app` | 73.25 ms | 16.75 ms | 59.7% → 1.3% |
| `GET /api/v1/meta/object` | 85.75 ms | 37.00 ms | 50.7% → 15.6% |
| `GET /api/v1/meta/view` | 13.25 ms | 11.25 ms | 11.8% → 3.1% |

Served bytes, SHA-256 prefix of each `GET /api/v1/meta/:type` body, before vs after on the first read after boot and on a warm read:

| Type | Bytes | Before | After, cold | After, warm |
|:--|--:|:--|:--|:--|
| app | 17,559 | `68ea5cb73ccd` | `68ea5cb73ccd` | `68ea5cb73ccd` |
| object | 694,011 | `3fe564c0fe63` | `3fe564c0fe63` | `3fe564c0fe63` |
| view | 23,954 | `71352ec4f6a6` | `71352ec4f6a6` | `71352ec4f6a6` |
| flow | 52,153 | `d35da2f62bcd` | `d35da2f62bcd` | `d35da2f62bcd` |
| dashboard | 12,075 | `ef3c4c852a3d` | `ef3c4c852a3d` | `ef3c4c852a3d` |
| page | 115,021 | `bf75d678c85d` | `bf75d678c85d` | `bf75d678c85d` |

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/meta-app-nav-servability-execution-read.test.ts` (new): the real REST handlers over the real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` and `SchemaRegistry`, with the `object` schema behind a recording proxy (the `rest-exposure-gate-execution-read.test.ts` instrument). Unscoped and environment-scoped: the app list and the app by name prune the unlistable entry and keep the listable one with **zero** object diagnostics; FALLBACK, a protocol without the execution list face, gets the same prune and diagnoses every object (so the zeros are not vacuous); CONTROL, `GET /meta/object` still serves `_diagnostics` on every object. On `cb0a2fcf`'s `rest-server.ts` the four zero rows fail (`expected [ 'listed_widget', 'unlisted_widget' ] to deeply equal []`).
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-app-nav-object-execution-face.test.ts` (new): through `HttpDispatcher.dispatch()`, `/meta/app` and `/meta/app/:name` read `object` on `getMetaItemsForExecution` and never on `getMetaItems`, with the same prune; without the execution face it falls back to `getMetaItems`. The two execution-face rows fail on `cb0a2fcf`'s `meta.ts`.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/metadata-diagnostics.memo.test.ts` (new): one parse per document per schema, a structurally equal copy and the decorated served body included; a changed document, a replaced schema each re-parse; a missing key vs the key holding `undefined`, `null` vs an array hole, `null` vs `NaN` each get their own verdict in both orders; a function, `-0`, a 300-deep nesting and a `Date` parse every time; callers get independent copies; the 4096 LRU bound evicts the least recently used. On the real `object` schema, a memo hit serves byte-identical `decorateMetadataItem` output to a fresh parse, for a valid and an invalid document. Mutation check: with a naive `JSON.stringify` key all six collision rows fail.
- `packages/rest/src/rest-exposure-gate-execution-read.test.ts` (re-pinned): its recording proxy is now registered per test (`beforeEach`), because verdicts are memoized per schema object; five rows recorded zero parses under one shared proxy.

Full suites: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 264 files / 21,505 tests, `@objectstack/rest` 328 / 6,730, `@objectstack/runtime` 448 / 8,011, all green. `typecheck` green for the three packages (test layers included for rest and runtime).

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 71 commands for this diff; all 71 ran with exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles 71 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Four were red on the first pass and green after:
- `check-rest-log-spy-declared`: the new rest test spied on `console.warn` without declaring `OS_REST_LOG`. The spies asserted nothing, so they are gone.
- `check:engine-double-contract`: the new rest test carried a `findOne` double no path reached. Dropped, so the pinned ledger is unchanged.
- `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`: shallow clone missing the pinned fixture commit; fetched it.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: prerequisite, seven packages had no `dist/`; built them.

`pnpm lint` green.

## Acceptance notes

- **`GET /meta/app` lands at 16.75 ms against the card's ≤15 ms.** What remains is not diagnostics (1.3%): the profile puts about 4.4 ms in artifact resolution (`lookupArtifactItem` / `foldExtenders`) and about 7.8 ms in fixed per-request overhead (`(program)`, routing, auth). Neither is on this claim's file surface. The maintainer relaxed both targets to these numbers (ruling 6408692677, letter A).
- **`GET /meta/object` lands at 15.6% in `computeMetadataDiagnostics` against the card's ≤5%.** Warm reads run no zod parse at all; the remaining 9.3 ms is the content key itself, one `JSON.stringify` plus SHA-256 over 694 KB of definitions (about 6 ms in an isolated bench) and the shape walk. A content key costs about one serialization, so content keying cannot reach 5%. The card's other route does: Studio opts in to `_diagnostics` with a query switch, and plain `/meta/object` reads skip them. That changes `/meta`'s parameters and the served body for every caller that does not opt in, and about a dozen `_diagnostics` readers in `ui/` would have to send the switch: a contract change, outside this claim (claim 6407697525). Reported to the seat as a finding; not dispatched (ruling 6408692677).
- **Deviation:** the before/after servers were started with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase dev -- --fresh -p 38425` rather than `pnpm dev`, because `check-dev-prereqs` refused `pnpm dev` with 45 unbuilt packages in this worktree. The same command and port served both sides.
